text: 中国人民银行行长潘功胜会见欧盟委员会经济和生产力委员东布罗夫斯基斯、欧洲中央银行行长拉加德、欧元集团主席皮埃拉卡基斯及欧洲有关国家央行行长。
text_en: PBOC Governor Pan Gongsheng met with European Commission Commissioner for Economy and Productivity Dombrovskis, European Central Bank President Lagarde, Eurogroup President Pierrakakis, and central bank governors of relevant European countries.
